semantics: Deterministic title-and-metadata triage for deciding what deserves a later fetch attempt. It is not evidence quality scoring, novelty assessment, abstract review, or full-text verification.

INTEGRITY_EVENT.description: Retraction, withdrawal, or expression-of-concern notice requiring record maintenance.

CORRECTION_EVENT.description: Correction, corrigendum, or erratum requiring record maintenance.

GUIDANCE.description: Guideline, position statement, or explicit expert-consensus guidance.

EVIDENCE_SYNTHESIS.description: Systematic, meta-analytic, umbrella, scoping, or network synthesis signalled by the title.

RANDOMIZED_TRIAL.description: Randomized or cluster-randomized trial signalled by the title.

REPLICATION_VALIDATION.description: Replication, reproducibility, or explicit external/independent validation.

SAFETY_SIGNAL.description: Safety, adverse-event, toxicity, self-harm, or mortality signal.

RESOURCE_BENCHMARK.description: Dataset, corpus, benchmark, or explicit data resource.

PROSPECTIVE_LONGITUDINAL.description: Prospective, cohort, or longitudinal design signal.

OBSERVATIONAL_DESIGN.description: Retrospective, case-control, or cross-sectional design signal.

SURVEY.description: Survey signal without a stronger path.

PRIMARY_METADATA.description: Primary bibliographic record with no recognised structural signal.
